system.description: The character and his horse work together seamlessly as natural partners. When the character attacks a target, the horse follows his lead and attacks the same target at the same time. Activating this Charm as part of an attack, the character's horse attacks the same target immediately after, benefiting from any onslaught penalty the character might have inflicted. This Charm can be used only when attacking a target that is also a valid target for the horse, and it does not count as the horse's action. The Charm provides an extra action for the horse.
system.source: Scroll of the Monk: The Imperfect Lotus
